notes: Intel's FY2023 10-K reports 124,800 employees as of Dec. 30, 2023 (131,900 in 2022), headquartered in Santa Clara, CA. The recipient is the public parent itself; the grants fund the New Albany (Licking County) fab project.

parent: Ultium Cells LLC (50/50 joint venture of General Motors Co. and LG Energy Solution)
notes: Ultium Cells is a JV formed in Dec. 2019 by GM (Detroit, MI) and LG Chem/LG Energy Solution (South Korea); the Lordstown plant itself had about 200 workers at end of 2021, 600+ at end of 2022 and a 1,100+ target for 2023. Bucket reflects the two owners (GM alone reports well over 100,000 employees in its 10-K); no single ultimate parent, so a skeptic could argue for either owner or a 'Korea' HQ.

FY2023 10-K: 64,088 employees worldwide at Dec. 31, 2023, about 75% in the US; headquartered in Cleveland, founded there in 1866. Grants support the new downtown Cleveland HQ and Brecksville R&D center; JobsOhio metrics list 3,524 retained jobs.

parent: University of Cincinnati (State of Ohio public university)
notes: Ohio Department of Development's Dec. 2022 Major Employers report lists University of Cincinnati at 10,512 Ohio employees (UC Health separately at 10,118); UC's own 2022 release says over 15,000 employees. Grants are Spec Development (OSIP) money for the Cincinnati Innovation District, not an operating business.

parent: The Ohio State University (State of Ohio public university)
notes: Ohio Department of Development's Dec. 2022 Major Employers report lists Ohio State University and Medical Center at 35,656 Ohio employees, fifth-largest employer in the state. No JobsOhio project-metrics row matched; the grants are likely innovation-district and research commitments (Columbus).

Cleveland Clinic reports 82,600 caregivers worldwide for 2024; the Dec. 2022 Ohio Major Employers report ranks it Ohio's largest employer at 56,986 in-state. Form 5500 shows 71,821 plan participants in 2023. Nonprofit 501(c)(3) health system, not an operating business; JobsOhio metrics show 17,745 retained jobs.

Bechtel Oil, Gas & Chemicals is the Houston-based unit of privately held Bechtel Group, which moved its HQ from San Francisco to Reston, VA by end of 2018 (EDGAR lists a CA address from older filings). The $20M paid in FY2020 was JobsOhio's site-work money for the PTTGC/Daelim Belmont County ethane cracker, routed to Bechtel as contractor. Bechtel's exact 2020 headcount was not found in its 2020 report; ~55,000 employees in 2022 per Wikipedia, and Bechtel was founded in California in 1898.

Amgen's FY2023 10-K lists Thousand Oaks, CA as principal executive office; approximately 26,700 staff at end of 2023 (28,000 in 2024). Grants support the New Albany biomanufacturing plant; JobsOhio metrics show 400 retained jobs.

Ohio Major Employers report (Dec. 2022) lists University Hospitals Health System at 30,891 Ohio employees, headquartered in Shaker Heights; UH's 2021 annual report says more than 30,000 employees. Form 5500 shows 34,924 participants in 2023. Nonprofit 501(c)(3) health system; no JobsOhio metrics row matched.

IPEDS-derived counts show about 1,485 faculty and 4,766 non-instructional staff (about 6,250 total) in 2023; Form 5500 shows 5,852 participants in 2023, consistent with 5,000+. Private nonprofit university in Cleveland, founded there (Western Reserve College 1826, Case School 1880). Grants likely tied to the Cleveland Innovation District.

parent: Cleveland State University (State of Ohio public university)
notes: IPEDS-derived counts show roughly 1,200 faculty and 1,000 administrative staff (about 2,300 total; a narrower count gives 1,369). Public university established in Cleveland in 1964. Grants likely tied to the Cleveland Innovation District; no JobsOhio metrics row matched.

Seefried is a privately held Atlanta industrial developer (founded 1984) with a few dozen employees (about 36 per directory data); it built and leased Amazon fulfillment centers in Ohio at North Randall (former Randall Park Mall, opened 2018) and Euclid, with JobsOhio revitalization money. The $14M in FY2018-2020 is a pass-through for Amazon-tenanted buildings, so the real beneficiary is Amazon (Seattle, WA, 5000+), not a small business.

IronUnits LLC is the Cleveland-Cliffs subsidiary that owns the Toledo HBI plant (130 permanent jobs). Cliffs' FY2019 10-K reports 2,372 employees at Dec. 31, 2019 (500-4999 for the FY2019 grant), then about 25,000 after the AK Steel and ArcelorMittal USA acquisitions in 2020, so the FY2020 and FY2022 grants fall in 5000+. Cleveland-based since 1847.

Ohio Major Employers report (Dec. 2022) lists Cincinnati Children's at 17,204 Ohio employees; Form 5500 shows 20,344 participants in 2019 and 27,933 in 2023. Nonprofit 501(c)(3) pediatric system founded in Cincinnati in 1883. JobsOhio metrics classify the $32M commitment as 'Other Loan'.

FirstEnergy Generation LLC was a wholly owned subsidiary of FirstEnergy Solutions, itself a subsidiary of Akron-based FirstEnergy Corp. (about 15,600 employees at end of 2017 per the 10-K). The $12.4M is the JobsOhio revitalization loan for cleanup of the retired R.E. Burger coal plant site in Belmont County, later forgiven and reported by Ohio Capital Journal; FES entered bankruptcy in 2018 and became Energy Harbor in 2020.

parent: PTT Global Chemical Public Company Limited (PTTGC), majority-owned by PTT Plc
notes: PTTGC America is the US arm of Bangkok-listed PTT Global Chemical (5,000-10,000 employees per directory data; PTT Plc, the Thai state oil company, holds the controlling stake). Partner Daelim (South Korea) withdrew in 2020. JobsOhio grants funded Belmont County cracker-site work; PTTGC repaid $20M in 2022 after failing to reach a final investment decision.

Honda Development & Manufacturing of America LLC (Marysville, OH; the 990 lists 'PA' in error) was formed April 1, 2021 by merging Honda's US manufacturing companies; its parent is Tokyo-based Honda Motor Co., about 194,993 consolidated employees at March 31, 2024 per the Form 20-F. Form 5500 for the EIN shows 41,442 participants under American Honda Motor Co. in 2023; JobsOhio metrics show 8,023 retained jobs and a $232M commitment tied to the EV hub.

parent: Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co., Ltd.
notes: Fuyao Glass America is the Moraine, OH subsidiary of Fuyao Glass Industry Group, Fuqing, Fujian, China (Shanghai/Hong Kong listed; about 18,000 employees worldwide per Dayton Daily News in 2016 and about 26,000 per D&B). The Moraine plant alone grew past 2,000 workers by 2017; Form 5500 participants rose from 233 in 2015 to 3,729 in 2019. JobsOhio grants: $5.6M for 800 jobs, $4M workforce, $6.6M for the 2016 expansion.

GE's FY2023 10-K reports about 125,000 employees at Dec. 31, 2023 (283,000 at end of 2018), headquartered in Boston, MA during FY2018-2023; after the April 2024 spin-offs GE Aerospace moved the HQ to Evendale, OH, so the FY2024 grant went to an Ohio-headquartered parent. The R&D grants go to GE Aviation/Aerospace in Evendale (6,450 retained jobs). GE was founded in New York in 1892.

Petmin USA is the subsidiary of Johannesburg-based Petmin, a private mining company (delisted from the JSE in 2017 after a private-equity-backed buyout) whose Somkhele anthracite mine employs roughly 1,000-1,600 people per company and trade-press sources. JobsOhio paid $5M economic development plus $5M revitalization for the $474M Ashtabula pig-iron plant, promised 110 jobs; the plant was still not built as of 2024, and no audited headcount for 2020 was found.
